text:
Priya (People Ops): Carlos in Sydney flagged his Nov paystub. It shows both Australian superannuation (SG) AND US 401(k) pre-tax deferral for the same salary line. He is on a local Aussie employment contract as of 2026-11-01. Can payroll + mobility check ASAP?

Paystub snippet:
```text
Gross: AUD 12,000
Superannuation (SG): AUD 1,140
401(k) pre-tax: USD 300 (converted)
PAYG tax: AUD 2,650
Net: AUD 8,010
```
Link to stub: <https://payroll.redwood/secure/stubs/CarlosV/2026-11>

Carlos V.: I switched to AU payroll 2026-11-01 per offer letter and lodged TFN/Super details. I saw the 401(k) contribution line and thought it was odd. I didn't opt in for any US deferrals after moving.

Jin (Payroll): Can someone share Payrun ID and GID? We need to confirm payroll country code on file generation time.

Marta (Payroll Ops): Payrun ID PR-20261130-21, GID RWF-7380. System shows country_code=AU now, but the export file included retirement element `401K_US_PRE`. Looks like the benefits vendor mapping kept the US deferral active despite country change.

payroll-bot: Ticket #PAY-12134 created: "Carlos V - duplicate super/401k after AU onboarding". Assigned to Marta. <https://payroll.redwood/tickets/PAY-12134>

Asha (Global Mobility): Mobility records show Carlos relocation effective 2026-10-28 and his Super fund and TFN were provided 2026-10-30. He should be on AU stat pay and not have US 401k deferrals. I'll attach onboarding docs to the ticket.

Tom (Tax): Two quick notes: 1) Australia SG is mandatory employer contribution; we must ensure employer SG was paid on the AU run. 2) If 401(k) deferrals were taken erroneously, payroll should reverse the US deferral and coordinate with the 401(k) vendor to refund employee contributions and correct year-to-date deferrals. We should avoid issuing a 1099/W-2 issue if reversals happen before US year-end filings.

Marta (Payroll Ops): Proposed steps: 1) Reverse `401K_US_PRE` element on PR-20261130-21 and run a net pay correction to restore Carlos's net. 2) Contact the 401(k) vendor to unwind the elective deferral and update contribution reports. 3) Confirm employer SG remittance schedule and include any catch-up if needed. ETA: aim to post reversals and net correction by next payroll (12/15) and start vendor contact today.

Jin (Payroll): Once reversals posted, send GL journals to payroll-recon. Also check benefits platform country flags to prevent recurring deferrals.

Carlos V.: Thanks  appreciate the quick action. Please DM me the timing so I know when to expect the correction. 

Priya (People Ops): Summary/action owners: Marta  reverse 401k + net correction + vendor contact; Asha  upload docs & confirm SG start; Jin  reconcile journals; Tom  confirm tax filing impact. Well update Carlos by EOD tomorrow.
